notes.en: Clearer typography with bundled Inter and Noto Sans SC fonts. Sharper native PNG product captures and a single set of window controls. Available as unsigned test builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
notes.zh: 应用捆绑 Inter 与 Noto Sans SC 字体，提升中英文阅读体验。使用更清晰的原生 PNG 画面，保留一组窗口控件。提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 未签名测试安装包。
